name: Testimonial.to
description:
Testimonial.to helps businesses collect, measure, and showcase
customer love through testimonials, case studies, brand
monitoring, and NPS.

With this connector, Claude works directly with your
Testimonial.to spaces: pulling and searching testimonials,
reviewing brand mentions found across X, LinkedIn, Reddit,
Hacker News, YouTube, and TikTok, checking NPS results and
case study responses, and curating your Wall of Love.

What Claude can do:
- Search and filter testimonials by text, rating, source, or status
- Report on testimonial volume, sentiment, source mix, and Wall of
  Love performance over any period
- Track brand mentions, sentiment, and share of voice by platform,
  and surface your best shoutouts
- Read NPS scores, response breakdowns, and trends over time
- Read case studies and their responses (Ultimate+)
- Add testimonials or mentions to the Wall of Love, or ignore
  mentions you don't want
- Manage Brand Monitor keywords, and set up automation routes that
  send matching mentions to Slack, a webhook, the Wall of Love, or
  a case study request
- Compare performance across spaces and check plan usage

Example prompts:
- "Show me every 5-star testimonial from the last 90 days that
  mentions onboarding."
- "How did our NPS trend last quarter, and what did detractors say?"
- "Find this week's best mentions on X and add the top three to the
  Wall of Love."
- "Draft a case study from our strongest testimonial this month."

Requires a Testimonial.to account. Brand Monitor, NPS, and case
study features depend on your plan. All write actions ask for
confirmation before they run.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Testimonial.to to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Testimonial.to to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.testimonial.to/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Testimonial.to MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Testimonial.to lists 35 MCP tools, including analytics_compareSpaces, analytics_summary, caseStudies_get, caseStudies_list, caseStudies_responses_get, caseStudies_responses_list, content_caseStudyFromTestimonial, keywords_add, keywords_delete, keywords_list, me_capabilities, and mentions_addToWallOfLove.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Testimonial.to?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Testimonial.to in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Testimonial.to requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Testimonial.to is developed by Testimonial.to. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
